uart.signal: a raw-register firmware (examples/nucleo-l031k6/firmware/main.c) enables RCC IOPENR/APB1ENR, puts PA2 on AF4 and writes USART2 TDR; the sim captures the banner STM32L031K6_OK and a uart_contains oracle matches it. A negative control that moves the USART2 clock gate to the wrong APB1ENR bit captures zero bytes.
uart.lane: core-ci board lane (configs/ci/boards.yml nucleo-l031k6, gate: true)

spi.gap: SPI1 is modelled on this die, but no firmware has been run that moves observable data on the bus. There is no Arduino-matrix row or raw-register SPI smoke for stm32l031k6 yet.

i2c.gap: I2C1 is modelled on this die, but no firmware has been run that moves observable data on the bus. There is no Arduino-matrix row or raw-register I2C smoke for stm32l031k6 yet.
